services.description: Timaphatikiza njira ya zinthu zolembedwa, kapangidwe ka tsamba, ndi ukadaulo kuti webusaiti yanu isangokhala pa intaneti, koma igwiredi ntchito.

services.0.description: Webusaiti ya portfolio kapena CV yanu kuti muwonetse mbiri yanu, zomwe mwakumana nazo, ndi ntchito zanu mwaukadaulo.

services.1.description: Landing page kapena mbiri ya kampani yomwe imatsegulidwa mwachangu, imawoneka yodalirika, ndipo yakonzeka kukopa makasitomala.
services.2.title: Dongosolo la zidziwitso ndi ntchito
services.2.description: Ma dashboard, ma portal, ndi machitidwe amkati othandiza kuyang'anira deta yanu ndi ntchito za bizinesi za tsiku ndi tsiku.
services.3.title: Automation
services.3.description: Sinthani ntchito zobwerezabwereza monga zidziwitso, kulumikiza zida, ndi kayendedwe ka ntchito kukhala zodzichitira zokha kuti gulu lanu lisunge nthawi.
process.description: Gawo lililonse limakhala ndi zotsatira zomwe mungathe kuziona, kuziyesa, ndi kuzivomereza. Mumadziwa bwino kumene ntchito yafika.
process.0.title: Kufufuza zosowa
process.0.description: Timalemba zolinga za bizinesi, zitsanzo za maonekedwe, zinthu zofunika, ndi zofunika kuyamba nazo.
process.1.title: Kuunikanso kapangidwe
process.1.description: Kapangidwe, maonekedwe, ndi kayendedwe zimawunikidwa ndi kuvomerezedwa pamodzi musanayambe kupanga.
process.2.title: Kupanga
process.2.description: Webusaiti, pulogalamu, kapena automation imapangidwa kuti igwire bwino pa chipangizo chilichonse, potsatira kapangidwe kovomerezeka.
process.3.title: Kuunikanso zotsatira
process.3.description: Zotsatira zimawunikidwa pamodzi, zimasinthidwa ngati kuli kofunika, ndi kuyesedwa mpaka zitakonzeka kutsegulidwa.
process.4.title: Kutsegulira ndi kupereka
process.4.description: Chinthucho chimasindikizidwa, metadata ndi SEO zimakonzedwa, kenako mumapatsidwa mwayi wolowera ndi malangizo.
services.0.long: Webusaiti ya portfolio kapena CV yanu ndi nyumba yanu yovomerezeka pa intaneti. Mbiri yanu, zomwe mwakumana nazo, ndi ntchito zanu zimasonkhanitsidwa bwino pa tsamba limodzi lomwe ndi losavuta kutumiza kwa olemba ntchito, makasitomala, kapena mayunivesite.

services.0.detail.1: Zithunzi za ntchito ndi mapulojekiti osankhidwa
services.0.detail.2: CV yotsitsa mu mtundu wa PDF
services.0.detail.3: Batani lolumikizirana ndi maulalo a malo ochezera
services.0.detail.4: Imagwira bwino pa mafoni ndi makompyuta
services.0.for: Omaliza maphunziro atsopano, ogwira ntchito paokha, opanga zinthu, ndi akatswiri amene akufuna kuoneka odalirika.
services.1.long: Landing page kapena mbiri ya kampani imathandiza bizinesi kusiya chithunzi chabwino poyamba. Timapanga kayendedwe ka tsamba, mawu, ndi maonekedwe kuti alendo amvetse msanga zomwe mukupereka ndi kulimbikitsidwa kukuyimbirani.
services.1.detail.0: Mawu omveka ndi odalirika a tsamba
services.1.detail.2: Fomu yolumikizirana ndi batani la WhatsApp
services.1.detail.3: Kukonza SEO kuti mupezeke mosavuta pa Google
services.1.for: Mabizinesi, masukulu, ma cafe, magulu, ndi makampani amene akufuna kuoneka aukadaulo.
services.2.long: Dongosolo la zidziwitso limakonza ntchito zomwe tsopano zili mwazika mu ma spreadsheet, zolemba, ndi mauthenga. Deta imakhala pamalo amodzi, imatha kufikiridwa potengera udindo, ndipo malipoti amatha kuwonedwa nthawi iliyonse.
services.2.detail.0: Kayendedwe ka ntchito kosavuta kotsatira momwe mumagwirira ntchito
services.2.detail.1: Maudindo a ogwiritsa ntchito ndi ufulu wolowera
services.2.detail.3: Kutumiza deta kunja kupita ku mafayilo
services.2.detail.4: Malo a admin oyang'anira zomwe zili mkati nokha
services.2.for: Masukulu, mabungwe, masitolo, minda, ndi makampani amene akufuna kuyang'anira deta mwadongosolo kwambiri.
services.3.long: Ntchito zobwerezabwereza monga kutumiza zidziwitso, kusuntha deta pakati pa mapulogalamu, kapena kupanga malipoti a nthawi zonse zimatha kuyenda zokha. Gulu lanu limasunga nthawi ndi kupewa zolakwika polemba.
services.3.detail.0: Kulumikiza mapulogalamu amene mumagwiritsa ntchito kale
services.3.detail.1: Zidziwitso zodzichitira zokha kudzera pa WhatsApp kapena imelo
services.3.detail.2: Kayendedwe kodzichitira ka chivomerezo ndi malipoti
services.3.detail.3: Kulemba deta ndi manja kumachepa kwambiri
services.3.detail.4: Yopangidwa potengera njira imene mukugwiritsa ntchito kale
services.3.for: Mabizinesi ndi magulu amene ali ndi ntchito zambiri zobwerezabwereza zochitidwa ndi manja.
process.0.long: Tisanapange chilichonse, timafuna kumvetsa bizinesi yanu: cholinga chake, alendo ndi ndani, ndi zinthu ziti zofunika kwambiri. Kuchokera pamenepo timakhazikitsa zofunika kuyamba nazo kuti ntchito ikhale yolunjika ndi kupewa kuwononga ndalama.
process.0.do.0: Kumvetsera zolinga ndi zomwe mukufuna pabizinesi yanu
process.0.do.1: Kusonkhanitsa maonekedwe omwe mumakonda ngati zitsanzo
process.0.do.2: Kusankha zinthu zazikulu ndi dongosolo la ntchito
process.0.you: Tiuzeni zosowa zanu ndi kugawana zitsanzo za mawebusaiti omwe mumakonda.
process.0.result: Mndandanda wa zosowa ndi zofunika kuyamba nazo zomwe tagwirizana pamodzi.
process.1.long: Choyamba timakonza kapangidwe ka tsamba ndi chithunzi cha maonekedwe. Mutha kuliunika ndi kupereka maganizo musanayambe kupanga, kuti zotsatira zomaliza zikhale pafupi ndi zomwe mumaganiza.
process.1.do.0: Kukonza kapangidwe ndi kayendedwe ka tsamba
process.1.do.1: Kupanga maonekedwe: mitundu, kapangidwe, ndi kalembedwe
process.1.you: Unikani kapangidwe, kenako perekani maganizo kapena chivomerezo.
process.1.result: Kapangidwe kogwirizana pamodzi ntchito yopanga isanayambe.
process.2.long: Kapangidwe kakavomerezedwa, webusaiti, pulogalamu, kapena automation imapangidwa. Imasintha bwino pa mafoni ndi makompyuta, ndipo mutha kupereka maganizo ntchito ikuchitika.
process.2.do.0: Kupanga masamba ndi zinthu kuchokera ku kapangidwe
process.2.do.1: Kuonetsetsa kuti ikuoneka bwino pa mafoni, ma tablet, ndi makompyuta
process.2.do.2: Kukonza zofunika kuti ipezeke mosavuta pa Google
process.2.you: Konzani mawu, zithunzi, ndi ma logo, ndipo perekani maganizo mukakhala nawo.
process.2.result: Mtundu woyamba womwe mungayese. Webusaiti yosavuta nthawi zambiri imatha pasanathe masiku 1–3 antchito zipangizo zikakonzeka.
process.3.long: Timayesa zotsatira pamodzi. Chilichonse chomwe sichili bwino chimasinthidwa, kenako chilichonse chimayesedwanso mpaka chigwire bwino pa zipangizo zosiyanasiyana ndi kukonzeka kutsegulidwa.
process.3.do.0: Kuyang'ana maonekedwe pa masikilini a makulidwe osiyanasiyana
process.3.you: Yesani zotsatira ndi kutiuza zomwe mukufuna kusintha.
process.4.long: Chinthucho chimasindikizidwa ndi kutsegulidwa kwa aliyense. Timachikonza kuti chipezeke mosavuta pa Google, kenako timakupatsani mwayi wolowera pamodzi ndi malangizo ogwiritsira ntchito kuti muziyang'anire mosavuta.
process.4.do.2: Kupereka mwayi wolowera ndi malangizo ogwiritsira ntchito
process.4.do.3: Kukuthandizani ndi chaka chimodzi cha kukonza kwaulere, kuphatikiza domain (phukusi la Small) kapena hosting (phukusi la Large)
process.4.you: Sungani mwayi wanu wolowera mosamala ndi kuyamba kuugawana ndi makasitomala anu.
process.4.result: Webusaiti kapena pulogalamu yatsegulidwa ndipo yakonzeka kugwiritsidwa ntchito.

faq.title: Mafunso omwe nthawi zambiri amabwera musanayambe.
faq.description: Ngati funso lanu silinayankhidwe pano, kukambirana kungathandize kudziwa zosowa zanu.
faq.0.question: Nocoding imatha kupanga ntchito zotani?
faq.0.answer: Timapanga mawebusaiti a portfolio kapena CV yanu, landing page kapena mbiri ya kampani, machitidwe a zidziwitso ndi ntchito, ndi automation ya njira za bizinesi.
faq.1.question: Kupanga kumatenga nthawi yaitali bwanji?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio, CV, kapena landing page yosavuta nthawi zambiri imatenga masiku 1-3 antchito zipangizo zikakonzeka. Mapulojekiti akuluakulu amadalira zosowa za zinthu, kulumikiza, ndi kuthamanga kwa maganizo omwe mumapereka.
faq.2.question: Kodi kapangidwe ndi zinthu zingasinthidwe?
faq.2.answer: Inde. Kapangidwe, kamangidwe ka masamba, zinthu, ndi kayendedwe ka ntchito zingasinthidwe malinga ndi zosowa zanu. Kapangidwe kadzawunikidwa pamodzi musanayambe kupanga.
faq.3.question: Kodi mtengo umaphatikizapo chiyani?
faq.3.answer: Mtengo umaphatikizapo kupanga potengera phukusi ndi ntchito zomwe tagwirizana. Phukusi la Small limaphatikizapo kukonza kwaulere ndi domain kwa chaka chimodzi, pomwe phukusi la Big limaphatikizapo kukonza kwaulere ndi hosting kwa chaka chimodzi.
contact.title: Tiuzeni zosowa za webusaiti yanu. Tidzakuthandizani kukonza njira.
contact.description: Tumizani chidule cha bizinesi yanu, masamba omwe mukufuna, ndi nthawi yomwe mukufuna. Yankho loyamba lidzakhala ndi malangizo a ntchito ndi masitepe otsatira. Kukambirana kumakhala kwaulere nthawi zonse, mukakhala mukufuna.
footer.tagline: Mawebusaiti a bizinesi okonzeka kutsegulidwa, owoneka odalirika, komanso osavuta kukulitsa.
project.category.ecoswap: Webusaiti ya msika wa katundu wogwiritsidwa ntchito
project.description.ecoswap: Msika wa pa intaneti wogulitsa ndi kugula katundu wogwiritsidwa ntchito. Anthu amatha kulemba, kuyang'ana, ndi kugula mosavuta kuchokera pa foni kapena kompyuta.
project.description.wiboost: Sitolo ya pa intaneti ya ntchito za digito monga kuika ndalama mu masewera, mapaketi a data, ndi mapulogalamu apamwamba, yokhala ndi ndalama za makasitomala ndi pulogalamu ya ogulitsanso.
project.description.ahawi: Webusaiti ya portfolio yanu yokhala ndi kalembedwe ka utoto wa madzi komanso zilankhulo ziwiri, yoonetsa mbiri, zomwe mwakumana nazo, ndi zolumikizirana.
project.description.abdi: Dongosolo la zolemba la antchito a ku nyumba yachifumu ya Keraton ku Surakarta (abdi dalem): kulembetsa, zambiri zaumwini, ndandanda ya zochitika, kupezeka, ndi kusindikiza makadi a chizindikiro.
project.description.sfarm: Pulogalamu yoyang'anira famu ya nkhuku zoikira mazira ndi mbuzi yomwe ndi ya mudzi: zolemba za tsiku ndi tsiku, malonda, ndalama zogwiritsidwa ntchito, ndi malipoti a ndalama.
project.description.payu: Nsanja yolumikiza anthu amene amaika ntchito ndi ogwira ntchito paokha. Obweretsa ntchito amapereka mphoto, ogwira ntchito amamaliza ntchito, ndipo malipiro amaperekedwa kudzera pa QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Mndandanda wa pa intaneti wokhala ndi katundu woposa chikwi chimodzi. Ogula amatha kufufuza, kusefa, ndi kuyitanitsa mwachindunji kudzera pa WhatsApp.
project.category.ianprem: Sitolo ya pa intaneti ya mapulogalamu apamwamba
project.description.ianprem: Sitolo ya pa intaneti ya maakaunti a mapulogalamu apamwamba monga Netflix ndi Spotify. Ogula amasankha ndi kulipira okha, pomwe ma admin amayang'anira katundu ndi malonda.
project.description.alengka: Mndandanda wa pa intaneti wa mipando ya mkati ndi yakunja ya ma cafe, malesitilanti, ndi nyumba. Alendo amatha kuyang'ana zosonkhanitsa ndi kukambirana kudzera pa WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Webusaiti yovomerezeka ya sukulu ya pulaimale yokhala ndi mbiri ya sukulu, zambiri zolembetsa ophunzira atsopano, mndandanda wa aphunzitsi, zochitika zina, ndi zomwe ophunzira apeza.
project.description.furnix: Mndandanda wa pa intaneti wa mipando yachitsulo yochokera ku Jepara ya ma cafe, malesitilanti, ndi nyumba. Alendo amatha kusankha katundu ndi kuyitanitsa malinga ndi zomwe amakonda.
project.category.clothique: Sitolo ya pa intaneti ya zovala
project.description.clothique: Sitolo yathunthu ya pa intaneti ya zovala: mndandanda, ngolo yogulira, malipiro a pa intaneti, blog, ndi malo a admin oyang'anira maoda ndi malipoti.
project.description.agli: Chida cha magulu opanga zinthu kuti asonkhanitse zitsanzo zowonedwa kwambiri, azindikire machitidwe, ndi kulemba zolemba zatsopano.
project.description.nebulist: Wothandizira malonda wa AI amene amapanga njira, zolemba za makasitomala omwe angakhalepo, ndi mauthenga oyamba kuchokera ku zambiri za katundu.
project.description.carbonfi: Pulogalamu ya ndalama za digito yogulitsa ma carbon credit (mphoto zochepetsera mpweya woipa) ndi mapulogalamu a mphoto okomera chilengedwe.
project.description.protectedpay: Pulogalamu yotetezeka yotumiza ndalama za digito: ndalama zimatulutsidwa pokhapokha zitalandiridwa, ndi malipiro a gulu ndi kusunga.
project.description.pedulichain: Nsanja yowonekera poyera yoperekera zopereka: chopereka chilichonse ndi momwe ndalama zagwiritsidwira ntchito zimalembedwa kwamuyaya ndipo aliyense amatha kuzionera.
project.description.astra: Wothandizira wa AI amene mumangolankhula naye kuti muyang'anire chuma cha digito, monga kutumiza ma token kapena kupanga zinthu zosonkhanitsa za digito, popanda kudziwa coding.
project.description.auditfi: Chida chofufuza chitetezo chozikidwa pa AI cha mapulogalamu a ndalama za digito chomwe chimapeza zofooka ndi kulemba lipoti m'masekondi.
project.description.p2p: Nsanja yosinthana chuma cha digito mwachindunji pakati pa ogwiritsa ntchito, yokhala ndi chitetezo cha malonda ndi malo a admin oyendetsera nsanjayo.
project.description.payguppy: Pulogalamu yothandiza masitolo wamba kulandira malipiro a ndalama za digito pogwiritsa ntchito ma QR code omwe ali nawo kale.
project.description.tiptap: Nsanja ya opanga zinthu yolandirira mphatso kuchokera kwa owonera mu ndalama za digito kapena zinthu zosonkhanitsa za digito, ndi zidziwitso panthawi ya live stream.
project.description.senkus: Masewera a pa intaneti okhala ndi mutu wa sayansi ndi alchemy: osewera amaphatikiza zakumwa, amasonkhanitsa zinthu za digito, ndi kupikisana mu arena.
project.description.quickstock: Pulogalamu ya kompyuta yoyang'anira katundu wa sitolo ya zovala: lembani malonda, katundu wochokera kwa ogulitsa, ndi malipoti a katundu, ndi mwayi wolowera potengera udindo wa wogwira ntchito aliyense.
project.description.caer: Nsanja yobwereketsa ndi kubwereka chuma cha digito pa ma network osiyanasiyana yothandizira IDRX, rupiah ya digito, kuti kusunga ndi kubwereka kukhale kosavuta.
